plain: Nice work decoding this warmup! To solve, submit this exact answer to the Game Master: cobalt-heron-77
generator_cmd: printf %s "$plain" | iconv -f utf-8 -t UTF-32LE | dd conv=swab status=none | xxd -p | tr -d '\n'  # UTF-32LE + dd swab -> 3412 word order ('N' = 00 4e 00 00)
oracle_cmd: printf %s "$encoded" | xxd -r -p | perl -0777 -ne 'print pack("N*", map { (($_ & 0xffff) << 16 | $_ >> 16) } unpack("N*", $_))' | iconv -f UTF-32LE -t utf-8  # perl: 16-bit halves of each word swapped -> plain UTF-32LE -> iconv
